title: Stop Saying "Very Small"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very small". Try one of these instead:
• Tiny: a tiny kitchen
• Minuscule: a minuscule amount
• Microscopic: microscopic creatures
• Miniature: a miniature train
• Compact: a compact car

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.

Find more words on anotherwordfor.net
